commitResults.messageBody:
Add a RelationshipGoal enumeration of six goals adapted from Hinge.
Each goal can be entered by its full name or a short keyword for fast
typing. Input ignores letter case and repeated spaces, and the full
goal name is stored.

Record an optional relationship goal in Person and save it in JSON.
A missing goal remains unknown, and older records without the field
remain readable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add relationship goal to add and edit commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Accept an optional rg/ parameter in add and edit. Invalid and
repeated values are rejected, rg/ with no value clears the goal in
edit, and edits to other fields preserve it. Command feedback shows
the goal, including Not specified when it is unknown.
